body: THREE COLOR CHOICES WITH REASONING. 1: #FF3A55 for incorrect. Changed from #E8334A. Why: compliance (#E8334A 4.09:1 FAIL) is only part. Design reason: #E8334A read as maroon at small sizes. #FF3A55 is high-chroma, reads as red at all sizes. Kai needs instant wrong signal. 2: #3FB950 for success. Same as GitHub merged color. Kai grew up with GitHub - borrowed semantic. He already knows this green means done. No learning cost. 3: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) for hover and tracks. Anti-choice: no brand color. ADHD hover states using brand colors pull attention. 0.08 is minimum perceivable hover without competing with content.
